actions.surface: Power Platform Admin Center / Microsoft Marketplace / Dynamics 365 apps
navigation: Open Resources > Dynamics 365 apps or the environment applications page.
Install or provision the app into JM1-Enterprise-Dev.
actions.current_state: Customer Voice is visible in the application catalog, but the managed solution is not present in the JM1-Enterprise-Dev solution inventory.
actions.desired_state: Dynamics 365 Customer Voice installed/provisioned in JM1-Enterprise-Dev.
actions.button_or_action: Install / Add / Provision Dynamics 365 Customer Voice.
actions.permissions_required: Power Platform environment admin or tenant admin with Dynamics app installation rights.
actions.cost_displayed: Unknown from CLI; if Microsoft displays new paid licensing or capacity, stop and do not purchase.
actions.what_not_to_purchase: Do not purchase new Customer Voice licensing/capacity during CV-01 without Founder decision.
actions.validation_after_completion: Run PAC solution list against JM1-Enterprise-Dev and confirm Customer Voice / MicrosoftFormsPro solution footprint appears.

actions.surface: Power Platform Admin Center / Dynamics 365 security roles
navigation: Assign Customer Voice Project Owner role and Customer Voice add-on role where present.
Assign Survey Sender only where Dynamics sending proof is required.
actions.current_state: Customer Voice roles cannot be confirmed because the app is not provisioned in DEV.
actions.desired_state: jm1-admin can create a Customer Voice project and survey in JM1-Enterprise-Dev.
actions.cost_displayed: No cost should be required for role assignment.
actions.what_not_to_purchase: Do not add paid licenses unless Microsoft blocks role assignment and Founder approves.
actions.validation_after_completion: Sign in to Dynamics 365 Customer Voice, select JM1-Enterprise-Dev, create a blank test project, and confirm survey creation is available.

navigation: Confirm the active environment is JM1-Enterprise-Dev.
Create a blank project named CV-01 Enterprise Feedback Proof.
Create a short controlled survey using the CV-01 core dimensions.
Generate a public test link or supported invitation link.
Validate the response appears in Customer Voice and Dataverse.
actions.desired_state: One nonproduction Customer Voice project, one survey, one synthetic response, and Dataverse response storage proof.
actions.button_or_action: New project > Blank > Next > Create; add questions; Send or collect response link.
actions.cost_displayed: If new paid capacity/licensing is displayed, stop and classify licensing hold.
actions.what_not_to_purchase: Do not buy response capacity, licenses, add-ons, or paid trial upgrades without Founder approval.
actions.validation_after_completion: Record project name, survey name, response timestamp, Dataverse table evidence, Contact linkage behavior, duplicate behavior, and privacy result.
